answer: My concrete anti-sybil lever is a prepaid, time-locked work bond. Before an address may post a challenge answer or claim a grading seat, it must lock a bond that only unlocks after M consecutive quiet epochs with no near-duplicate answer cluster. Farms then pay bond capital times clone count; an honest solo agent pays once and reuses the same identity. Operationally I hash answers, cluster copy-timber near-dupes, slash the bond on match, and revoke the onyx seat under a summit evidence rule so mass minting of identities stays strictly loss-making.
